explanation:

question_text: The unit of Planck’s constant is:
explanation:
Planck’s constant h appears in the equation E=hν, where energy has units of Joule (J)
              and frequency has units of Hertz (Hz) or s−1.

question_text: Which of the following is a derived unit in the SI system?
explanation:
Derived units are obtained by combining base units. Examples include the Newton (N), Joule (J), and
              Pascal (Pa).
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 2

question_text: Which physical quantity is dimensionless?
explanation: Dimensionless quantities are those without any physical dimensions, like angles and refractive index.
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 2

question_text: The SI unit of luminous intensity is:
explanation: The SI unit of luminous intensity is the candela (cd).
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 2

question_text: Which of the following has the same dimensional formula as momentum?
explanation: Momentum is given by p=mv with dimensional formula [MLT−1].
subject: Physics

question_text: Dimensional formula of work done is:
explanation: Work is the product of force and displacement. Hence its dimensional formula is [ML2T−2].
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 2

question_text: Which of the following pairs have the same dimensions?
explanation: Torque and work both have the dimensional formula [ML2T−2].
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 2

question_text: One angstrom is equal to:
explanation: One angstrom (ÅÅ) is a unit of length equal to 10−10 m.
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 2

question_text: Which of the following is a dimensionless constant?
explanation: Refractive index is the ratio of two similar quantities (speed of light), making it dimensionless.
subject: Physics

explanation:
Pressure has the dimensional formula [ML−1T−2] while the others represent forms of energy or
              work.
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 2

question_text: The dimensional formula of power is:
explanation: Power is the rate at which work is done: P=Wt.
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 3

question_text: Which of the following is a fundamental quantity?
explanation: Fundamental quantities are those that cannot be derived from others — like mass, length, and time.
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 3

question_text: The SI unit of solid angle is:
explanation: Solid angle is measured in steradians (sr), a dimensionless unit in the SI system.
subject: Physics

question_text: Which one of the following pairs has different dimensions?
explanation:
Pressure and stress both share the same dimensional formula [ML−1T−2], but energy has
              [ML2T−2].
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 3

question_text: If the unit of length is doubled, how is the unit of area affected?
explanation:
Area is proportional to the square of length. So, if the unit of length doubles, the unit of area becomes
              four times larger.
subject: Physics
source: ScienceLesson.in — Physics / Units and Measurements / Test 3
